bio.text: Denise Jones Ennett represents District 80 in the Arkansas House of Representatives, which includes part of Little Rock and Pulaski County, and is serving her fourth term.
Ennett earned a Bachelor of Arts in history from the University of Texas at Arlington and a Master of Arts in higher education/college affairs from the University of Arkansas at Little Rock.
She has worked as a parent mentor for The Center for Exceptional Families and served on the Little Rock Arts and Culture Commission. She lives in downtown Little Rock.
